name: Wei Zhao
bio: Wei Zhao's fascination with motorsport began during his university days, poring over race data and strategy simulations. He earned a degree in engineering and quickly transitioned into the world of racing, initially working as a data analyst for a Formula 4 team. His analytical skills and innovative ideas led him to quickly climb the ranks. He believes in a data-driven approach to strategy, constantly seeking new ways to optimize performance through simulation and analysis. Wei is known for his ability to anticipate competitor moves and formulate counter-strategies that can turn the tide of a race. His loyalty to the team is unwavering, and he strives for perfection in every aspect of his work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei is of average height, with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with race notes and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers to eat only spicy food before a race, claiming it sharpens his focus.
